seo.title: Embed SDK Docs — Flowtali
seo.description: Learn how to embed Flowtali invoices, projects, receipts, and more in your own product using the Flowtali Embed SDK.

overview.title: Embed SDK
overview.intro: The Flowtali Embed SDK lets you embed any Flowtali view — invoices, projects, receipts, clients, letterheads, preferences, and more — directly in your own website or SaaS product. Your users get the full Flowtali experience without leaving your platform.
overview.card1Desc: Drop in a single JS file and call three lines of code.
overview.card2Desc: Your backend issues short-lived tokens. No shared passwords.
overview.card3Desc: Match your brand with colors, fonts, and border radius.

quickstart.title: Quick start
quickstart.subtitle: Get an invoice list embedded in under 10 minutes.
quickstart.step1Title: Generate an API key in Flowtali
quickstart.step1Body: Go to Org Settings → API Keys and create a new key. You'll receive a pk_live_ (publishable) and a sk_live_ (secret) key. Store the secret key securely — it is shown only once.
quickstart.step2Title: Generate an embed token from your backend
quickstart.step2Body: When one of your users logs in, your server calls the Flowtali API to mint a short-lived token for them. The sk_live_ key must never leave your server.
quickstart.step3Title: Add the SDK and mount the embed
quickstart.step3Body: Pass the token from Step 2 to the SDK. Pick whichever framework you're using below.

auth.title: Authentication
auth.subtitle: The embed uses a two-key system, the same model as Stripe.
auth.pubKeyDesc: Safe for frontend / browser code. Passed to Flowtali.init(). Identifies your organization but cannot generate tokens or access data directly.
auth.secretKeyDescPre: Server-side only. Never ship this in frontend code or commit it to git. Used to call
auth.rateLimit: Embed tokens are rate-limited to 30 generations per minute per IP and expire after a maximum of 24 hours (expires_in max is 86400).

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.intro: Each embed token carries a permissions array. The embed blocks any action not explicitly granted — even if the UI renders the option. Grant only what each user actually needs.

descs.invoices.read: View invoice list and individual invoices
descs.projects.read: View project list and individual projects
descs.receipts.read: View receipt list and individual receipts
descs.clients.read: View client list and individual client records
descs.letterheads.read: View letterhead list and individual letterheads

views.title: Available views
views.intro: Pass any of these as the view param to ft.mount() or ft.open(). For views with a dynamic ID, pass the ID via params.

descs.invoices: Invoice list with search and filters

appearance.title: Appearance / theming
appearance.intro: Pass an appearance object to Flowtali.init() to apply your brand globally, or override per-mount call.

events.title: Events
events.intro: Listen for actions inside the embed with ft.on(). Events fire after successful mutations — not on validation errors or cancelled actions. Use them to sync your own system, show toasts, or update UI state.

descs.invoice.created: A new invoice was successfully created
descs.invoice.updated: An invoice was edited and saved
descs.project.created: A new project was successfully created
descs.project.updated: A project was edited and saved
descs.receipt.created: A new receipt was successfully created
descs.receipt.updated: A receipt was edited and saved
descs.client.created: A new client was successfully created
descs.client.updated: A client record was edited and saved

reference.title: SDK reference
reference.initDesc: Initializes the SDK. Returns a FlowtaliInstance.
reference.initAppearanceDesc: Default theme applied to all mounts from this instance.
reference.mountDesc: Mounts the embed inside a container. selector can be a CSS string or a DOM element.
reference.mountViewDesc: Which view to render. See Available views.
reference.mountTokenDesc: Short-lived embed JWT from your backend.
reference.mountParamsDesc: Optional query params forwarded to the view, e.g.
reference.mountAppearanceDesc: Per-mount theme override, merged over init appearance.
reference.openDesc: Same as mount() but renders inside a centered overlay modal with a backdrop and close button. Accepts the same options.
reference.onDesc: Subscribe / unsubscribe to embed events. Use '*' to catch all events — handler receives (eventName, data).
reference.destroyDesc: Removes the iframe or modal and clears all state. Call this in your component's unmount / cleanup hook to avoid memory leaks.
reference.configDesc: Override the Flowtali base URL before calling init(). Useful for staging environments or self-hosted deployments.
